summary: This is an 8-K filed by Iron Dome Acquisition I Corp. reporting the completion of its initial public offering (IPO) of 15,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit and a private placement of 2,750,000 warrants at $1.00 per warrant, along with the subsequent partial exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option for 700,000 units. Net proceeds of $157,785,000 were placed in a trust account for the benefit of public shareholders, to be held until a business combination or redemption. This is a routine SPAC IPO filing, not a special situation event.
